metadata.description: Skills Mike Landry uses every day to work with AI, shared by Cairo Labs.

plugins.name: brief-me
plugins.description: Makes your AI report like a good chief of staff: verdict first, one decision at a time, no narration of its homework.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Pass work from one AI chat to the next without re-explaining: a self-contained note on the way out, a quick check-and-archive on the way in.

plugins.name: tldr
plugins.description: One command to take stock of a chat: a quick status that keeps the chat open, or a clean close-out that leaves nothing behind.
